display_name: 恢复器无TX标签选模校核与原目标预测独立评分恢复
description: 七种恢复器训练自监督边界及扩散/流端点检查；纯源波形NMSE规则同样选择U-Net，复用此前已经冻结的全部1200条七视图预测，仅修正真值目录的CPU评分调用，不训练或重做预测。
authorization: 原任务完整授权恢复器研发及冻结F验证；最新要求无监督学习首先正确。原预测已完成，原评分因N607真值路径与本地布局不同而在读真值前失败。

code.environment: N607 existing CVS-RFFI; CPU independent scorer

data.version: original validated source physical split; no resplit
data.representation: equalized=1, center256, original packet RMS; practical residual/post_sync/noeq at25MHz
data.physical_ids_ref: same contract#role_ids; V panel chosen perRX/day without TX labels using fixed data seed
data.label_map_ref: source_cache/manifest.json#class_id_to_tx; label files read only by independent scorer
data.tx_sets_ref: all original six TX; restoration training uses no TX labels
data.validation_ref: source_cache/manifest.json: READY/EXACT_MATCH; reuse existing cache without new data validation
data.leo_config_ref: experiments/pamf_restoration/data.py: six practical residual/noEQ/fixed one source training draw per physical ID

target_panel.selection: uniform physical-ID panel; source-selected single candidate only; new six practical paired diagnostics, not historical satellite observations

permissions.regime: Phase1 fixed prediction diagnostic; restoration training and waveform-only selection use no TX labels; existing F was pretrained supervised
permissions.query_use: fixed per-sample prediction; all7 views and fixed stochastic diagnostics complete before independent scorer opens TX truth
permissions.claim_scope: Selection audit is added after all seven source diagnostics, before successful target truth scoring. It is not a new prospectively blinded selection experiment. No target feedback or parameter updates.

checkpoint.initialization: No training; reuse original final U-Net
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: existing cleanF E200 and AsF T1 E20+10 source_contract and complete scratch-parent lineage; exact local source roles matched; frozen.py
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: F checkpoints VERIFIED: cleanF scratch E200/defaulthead; AsF scratch20+own10/defaulthead. Restoration inherits no weights; fixed F used only for post-freeze evaluation.

selection_rule.primary: minimum mean raw IQ NMSE across six source practical views
selection_rule.constraints: clean->clean NMSE<=.02; no TX labels/F scores/features/stochastic classification
selection_rule.fallback: If no clean-qualified model, minimum clean NMSE, then minimum practical NMSE; negative confirmation only

execution.gpu_policy: CPU only; zero GPU workers, zero training, original predictions referenced read-only
execution.launch_command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python -X utf8 -m experiments.pamf_restoration.runner score --reference ../../runs/20261019-phase1-pamf-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m7-r01/target_inputs --row-output ../../runs/20261019-phase1-restoration-unlabeled-confirmation-s2026092701-r01/unet --target-truth ../../runs/20260927-phase1-baselines-final-clean-satellite-m5-r01/data/truth.json
execution.stop_rule: Abort if original seven-view prediction marker/shape/ID checks fail or output exists; no automatic retraining or reprediction.

metric_names: paired-clean feature vs other-TX margin (truth-side diagnostic only)
three fixed draw class switch rate
metrics_plan.primary: Primary frozen AsF default-head paired accuracy, net corrections, true TX margin; cleanF secondary; clean plus six practical, all1200 IDs fixed before scorer truth access.

rows.seed_notes: split is original contract; data seed fixes source V panel and native source scene/noise draw; augmentation fixes receiver sessions/clean mask and training diffusion/flow RNG; support not applicable; target panel seed separately fixed.
rows.budget_ref: No new optimization or prediction; source parent E20/4940 updates unchanged.
rows.command: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= OMP_NUM_THREADS=2 python -X utf8 -m experiments.pamf_restoration.runner score --reference ../../runs/20261019-phase1-pamf-restoration-selfsup-manysig-m7-r01/target_inputs --row-output ../../runs/20261019-phase1-restoration-unlabeled-confirmation-s2026092701-r01/unet --target-truth ../../runs/20260927-phase1-baselines-final-clean-satellite-m5-r01/data/truth.json

notes: Original main run remains FAILED_TECHNICAL at scoring; preserve all artifacts and failed traceback.

Waveform-only selector input contains candidate, clean NMSE, mean six-practical raw NMSE and identity NMSE only; rejects TX/F fields. Deterministic result U-Net matches original labeled-V selection, permitting exact prediction reuse.
This audit does not retroactively describe the original labeled-V source selection as unsupervised. Training has zero TX-label reads; paired clean IQ remains necessary source reference.

Original archive transfer/compile, real-checkpoint no-query smokes and matching validated data reused; no new code landing or GPU launch. Focused six audit tests passed; independent P0/P1 review of the truth-path fix passed.
No target-score-based model selection, parameter tuning, added training, altered sample panel or channel regeneration.
